title: Grateful Dead Live at Monterey Performing Arts Center on 1969-06-14
lineage: SBD > MCass > Cass > DAT > ZA2 > SF > CD > mkwACT > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1969 show, highlighted by a scorching Eleven and double Lovelight sandwich.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently praised for its manic energy, with The Eleven, two Lovelights, Dark Star, St. Stephen and Friend of Mine singled out as standout moments.  Recording quality is described as an average‑to‑good soundboard mix – a little muddy in places and with a brief dropout on St. Stephen, but overall clear enough to enjoy the intense jams.  Fans consider this one of the top ’69 shows, especially for Garcia’s guitar fireworks and Pigpen’s vocal power.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews overwhelmingly praise the musical performance (many 5‑star comments) while noting only modest recording flaws; the strong show weight (70%) drives a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally balanced mix, B+‑ish sound; a bit muddy and not the clearest board, with a brief dropout at the end of St. Stephen and occasional ambience bleed, but overall listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show opens with a fiery Lovelight, rolls through classic early‑'69 material, then builds into an intense Dark Star → St. Stephen → Eleven suite before returning to a second Lovelight and closing with high‑octane jams; the pacing is described as manic, energetic and tightly woven.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for blistering, creative runs on The Eleven, Dark Star and throughout; called “possessed” and “mind‑melting.”
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass work praised as tight and rhythmic during the Eleven and St. Stephen; noted for sparkling runs.
band_member_comments.Keys: Mentions of Tom’s B3 sounding like a backup keyboard, occasional “backup keyboard” tone; otherwise keyboards described as solid in Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Drums: A unique drum solo before the second Lovelight is highlighted; overall rhythm section praised.
